statement: The fibred and opfibred Grothendieck constructions give the specified span C <- C_u -> C_infinity; no general direct C -> C_infinity functor is supplied.
notes: Variance and map directions fixed explicitly.

statement: For every filtered indexing category A and every D:A->Cat, the canonical Grothendieck-total-category to Cat-colimit functor is a weak equivalence; the sequential fibred version follows by opposites.
notes: No full-faithfulness, injectivity, or fibrancy of transition functors. Componentwise extension includes empty A.

statement: A base functor u:J->T induces weak equivalences of fibred total categories for every strict F:T^op->Cat iff every u/t is weakly contractible.
notes: Necessity is for all F, not for a specified diagram or the restricted homotopy-hypothesis class.

statement: Preorder cofinality plus homotopy of parallel reindexing maps does not imply the total/sequential comparison is a weak equivalence.
notes: T=B C2, constant terminal fibre, constant identity sequence. The manuscript already identifies this obstruction. Full finite check attached.

statement: Total W_infinity-asphericity of A does not make every Cat-valued colimit homotopically correct: for Delta_inj and D([n])=B N^(n+1), the total category has integral H_k=Z in every degree whereas the Cat colimit has type S1.
notes: Positive-degree homology diagrams are projective representables; no need to assume general exactness to calculate total homology.

statement: Delta_inj has exact abelian-group-valued colimits and is totally W_infinity-aspherical but is not filtered.
notes: Full independent recheck of the integral affine-cone argument supplied.

statement: For nonempty connected shapes, filtered categories are contained in the universally correct Cat-colimit shapes, which are strictly contained in the totally W_infinity-aspherical shapes.
notes: Discrete diagrams prove the necessary upper bound. Property is componentwise for disconnected A.

statement: An exact intrinsic classification of universally correct Cat-colimit shapes, including whether all connected such shapes are filtered, remains unresolved here.
notes: Exact gap and residual infinite-with-no-weakly-terminal scope recorded; no claim of literature-wide openness.

statement: The last-element map sd P->P for the six-face triangle-boundary poset is a weak equivalence with no inverse modulo zigzags of natural transformations; all 456 reverse monotone maps have degree zero.
notes: Full finite enumeration and output attached. Does not itself decide the particular path map q_L.

statement: An acyclic map of small CW spaces is an epimorphism in the unpointed homotopy category, with weakly equivalent double-pushout codiagonal.
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: GALOIS B.9 verification; CATHOT E.17 reduction
notes: Classical claim with checked primary citations and complete proof.

statement: Every small group embeds in a simple nonabelian integrally acyclic group of any prescribed infinite small cardinality at least its size.
notes: Simultaneous HNN and mitosis construction, including cardinal control, independently checked.

statement: KT_mu holds: every connected small CW complex has an acyclic BG presentation whose perfect kernel is killed by every homomorphism to any group of size at most mu.
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: GALOIS B.11 verification; KT_mu; CATHOT E.17
notes: Subcomplex injectivity induction, twisted homology, kernel description, and all universe bounds verified.

statement: If a presheaf ind-represented by a nonempty small filtered system of categories modulo natural transformations inverts W_infinity on all small shapes, it inverts W_1 and the specified groupoid-completion unit is an ind-isomorphism with the same indexing category.
notes: No space representability premise. Empty test shapes, arbitrary components, and noninvertible endomorphisms included.

statement: All-small-shape homotopy invariance of the constant-to-constant localization Hom functor for a small relative category forces factorization through Pi_1; if represented by a space, that space is a 1-type.
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: V ms.44-46; Lead 3 size correction; CATHOT E.17
notes: The countable path system satisfies the small-index hypothesis. Bounded shape classes do not support this conclusion.
